items: 1/2 tsp Aleppo pepper, plus more for serving

steps: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium/low heat. Add onion and garlic. Cook until softened and fragrant. Stir in tomatoes. Season with Aleppo pepper, salt, and pepper.
Turn the heat down to low and cover, stirring occasionally, until a jammy sauce forms.
While the sauce is simmering, cook the pasta according to package instructions to al dente, saving at least 1 cup pasta water.
Use an immersion blender (or transfer to a regular blender) to blend the tomatoes until smooth, then stir in the butter and lemon juice.
Add cooked pasta to the tomato sauce. Toss to coat. Add a little bit of pasta water to thin out the sauce as needed.
Serve topped with fresh grated Parmesan and an extra sprinkle of Aleppo pepper. Serves 2-4ish.
